_comment: Template. On first run this is copied to urls.json (git-ignored, your real environments). One entry per environment: the site's base URL that tests and the recorder use. Mark exactly one "default": true — that's the environment used when TEST_ENV isn't set. Edit these in-app via Environments, or by hand here.
_examples: The 'demo' / 'demo2' entries below point at safe PUBLIC sites so the committed @example tests run zero-config on a fresh clone (and let you demo a simultaneous multi-environment run). Replace them with your own staging/production URLs — those live only in git-ignored urls.json.

_login._comment: How your app's login form works, so login('role') and pre-auth recording can drive it — set once here (shared by every env), or override per env by adding a "login" block to that env below. Selectors are Playwright locators; "submit" is the button's visible text (matched case-insensitively). Values live only in git-ignored urls.json.
